topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Oh, I can't believe this happened. I thought everything was set, and now... I don't even know what to say. I mean, it was supposed to be the perfect surprise, you know? We all put so much effort into it, picking out your favorite snacks, planning the games, even decorating the room exactly how you like. Everyone was so excited to see your face when you walked in. It's just... it’s a mess now, and I really wished it didn’t turn out this way. I hope you know that no matter what, we're all here for you, and we’ll find another way to celebrate, okay?
